$comment: Source of truth for the Cloudflare MCP portal mapping of server `api` on portal `mcp` (mctlhq/.github#35, mctlhq/mctl-api#276). Every tool this server registers must appear here with an explicit decision; internal/mcp/portal_allowlist_test.go fails the build otherwise. An enabled tool must be recorded readOnly in internal/mcp/annotations_test.go AND carry a `reason` saying what it exposes and why that is acceptable on the private aggregate: readOnlyHint is a side-effect hint, not a privacy classification, and the log and incident tools return application text. Apply with scripts/portal-allowlist-apply.sh.

tools.name: mctl_get_dev_loop
tools.reason: Liveness of one DevLoop workflow by id: status and phase only, no code, no secrets; the upstream refuses ids outside the caller's tenants.

tools.name: mctl_get_incident
tools.reason: Incident record with collected evidence (log excerpts, analysis, PR links); tenant-scoped by the upstream. Excerpts can carry application log text, acceptable on a private admin-only aggregate.

tools.name: mctl_get_openclaw_sizing_recommendation
tools.reason: Aggregated VictoriaMetrics resource history and a recommended profile for one OpenClaw service; numbers only, tenant-scoped upstream.

tools.name: mctl_get_operation
tools.reason: Schema of one platform operation: parameter names, types, defaults and risk level. Catalogue metadata with no tenant data.

tools.name: mctl_get_resource_usage
tools.reason: CPU, memory and pod quota usage for a team workspace; capacity figures only, tenant-scoped by the upstream.

tools.name: mctl_get_service_config
tools.reason: Service configuration as recorded in GitOps: image tag, host, port, component type, database flag. No secret values; tenant-scoped upstream.

tools.name: mctl_get_service_logs
tools.reason: Raw recent log lines from Loki for a service the caller may read. Logs can contain application data; the upstream enforces tenant scope and the portal is private to admins and pilot members, so the exposure equals what the caller already has.

tools.name: mctl_get_service_status
tools.reason: ArgoCD sync and health state plus the service's recorded configuration; operational metadata, tenant-scoped upstream.

tools.name: mctl_get_tenant
tools.reason: Team workspace details: members, quotas, deployed services. Member logins are platform identities the caller can already see; tenant-scoped upstream.

tools.name: mctl_get_workflow_logs
tools.reason: Argo Workflow step logs from the archive for a workflow the caller may read. Same class as service logs: may carry build output; tenant-scoped upstream, private portal.

tools.name: mctl_get_workflow_status
tools.reason: Status and step summary of one Argo Workflow run; operational metadata, tenant-scoped upstream.

tools.name: mctl_incident_summary
tools.reason: Aggregate counts of active incidents by status, severity and type; no incident bodies, no tenant data.

tools.name: mctl_list_agent_executions
tools.reason: Durable execution records of DevLoop runs: agent version, workflow id, result. Pipeline metadata; tenant-scoped upstream.

tools.name: mctl_list_agent_versions
tools.reason: Published versions of an mctl-agents agent with manifest, git SHA, image reference and prompt hash; release metadata, no tenant data.

tools.name: mctl_list_domains
tools.reason: Custom and generated domains for a team or service with verification status; hostnames only, tenant-scoped upstream.

tools.name: mctl_list_incidents
tools.reason: Incident list with status, severity and one-line summary; summaries are alert titles, tenant-filtered by the upstream.

tools.name: mctl_list_openclaw_identity
tools.reason: File names of a team's OpenClaw identity overrides in GitOps; names only, tenant-scoped upstream.

tools.name: mctl_list_openclaw_skills
tools.reason: File names of a team's OpenClaw skills in GitOps; names only, tenant-scoped upstream.

tools.name: mctl_list_operations
tools.reason: Catalogue of platform operations with parameters and risk levels; discovery metadata, no tenant data.

tools.name: mctl_list_platform_skills
tools.reason: Platform-wide skills visible to the caller after visibility and binding filters; catalogue metadata the upstream already scopes.

tools.name: mctl_list_previews
tools.reason: Preview environments of a team with health and sync state; namespace names and status, tenant-scoped upstream.

tools.name: mctl_list_recent_agent_runs
tools.reason: Last ten mctl-agents triggers: operation, mode, service, status, who triggered; operator activity metadata, admin-scoped by the upstream.

tools.name: mctl_list_recent_operations
tools.reason: Recent audit-log entries: who ran which operation when and the workflow it started. Operator activity the caller may already see; upstream-scoped.

tools.name: mctl_list_repos
tools.reason: GitHub repositories the team's App installations expose for deployment; repository names and visibility, tenant-scoped upstream.

tools.name: mctl_list_services
tools.reason: Deployed services with team, image tag, host and database flag; operational metadata, tenant-filtered by the upstream.

tools.name: mctl_list_tenant_skill_bindings
tools.reason: Skill bindings per tenant; admins see all, members their own — the upstream applies that filter, the tool exposes only binding names.

tools.name: mctl_list_tenants
tools.reason: All team workspaces with quotas and member counts; admin-only at the upstream, which refuses non-admins (measured through the portal).

tools.name: mctl_list_workflows
tools.reason: Recent Argo Workflow runs for a team's namespace: names, status, timestamps; tenant-scoped upstream.

tools.name: mctl_read_openclaw_identity
tools.reason: Raw content of one identity override file (AGENTS.md, SOUL.md, IDENTITY.md, USER.md, TOOLS.md) from the team's GitOps directory; prompt text the team authored, tenant-scoped upstream.

tools.name: mctl_read_openclaw_skill
tools.reason: Raw content of one OpenClaw skill file from the team's GitOps directory; team-authored text, tenant-scoped upstream.

tools.name: mctl_read_platform_skill
tools.reason: Content of a platform-wide skill from the GitOps catalogue, subject to the caller's visibility; catalogue text, no tenant data.

tools.name: mctl_resolve_agent
tools.reason: Which agent version is released to an environment; release pointer only, no tenant data.

tools.name: mctl_whoami
tools.reason: Returns only the caller's own user id, admin flag, teams and namespaces — the identity probe the aggregate portal's A≠B check calls; nothing about anyone else.
